seed.title: Move away from the Mumbai and Raigad coast
seed.body: A storm surge of about 3 m and winds above 150 km/h are expected near landfall. People living within 5 km of the shore should reach cyclone shelters before dark.

seed.title: Koli fishing villages: leave and secure boats
seed.body: Pull boats above the high-tide line and move families to shelters. Sea conditions will be dangerous from tomorrow evening.

seed.title: Landfall likely in about 48 hours near Mumbai
seed.body: The predicted track has 72% confidence at landfall. Expect it to cross the Konkan coast as a Category 3 cyclone.

seed.title: The storm is strengthening quickly
seed.body: Winds rose 15 knots in 12 hours and cloud tops cooled to -86 °C. More strengthening is likely before landfall.

seed.title: Heavy rain of 200 mm or more is possible
seed.body: Urban waterlogging in Mumbai and flooding of low roads and rivers is likely 36 to 60 hours from now. Suburban rail may be disrupted.

seed.title: New INSAT-3DR image confirms a shrinking eye
seed.body: The eye is now 28 km wide. All satellite sources agree on the storm's centre within 9 km.

live.title: Latest forecast shifts the track 18 km north
live.body: Thane and Palghar now carry the highest surge risk. Shelter plans for Vasai-Virar should be reviewed.
